purpose: Replace the dead-end past-epoch skip in ingest() with MIP-03 convergence logic: roll back to the epoch snapshot and re-apply the deterministically-better commit when a competing commit arrives for an epoch already advanced past.

public_api.name: RollbackInfo
public_api.signature: export interface RollbackInfo { groupId: Uint8Array; targetEpoch: bigint; newHeadCommitEventId: string; invalidatedMessages: string[]; messagesNeedingRefetch?: string[]; }
public_api.description: Describes a completed rollback to a prior epoch. invalidatedMessages and messagesNeedingRefetch are populated in S3; S2 emits with empty arrays.

public_api.name: isBetterCandidate
public_api.signature: export function isBetterCandidate(candidate: { id: string; created_at: number }, applied: { eventId: string; createdAt: number }): boolean
public_api.description: MIP-03 tiebreak: true when candidate is the deterministically better commit. Earliest created_at wins; on tie, lexicographically smallest event id wins.

public_api.name: isReplayOfApplied
public_api.signature: export function isReplayOfApplied(candidate: { id: string; content: string }, applied: { eventId: string; contentHash: Uint8Array }): boolean
public_api.description: Replay guard: true when candidate is a re-delivery of the already-applied commit (same id or matching SHA-256 content hash).

public_api.name: sortGroupCommits (updated)
public_api.description: Now delegates to isBetterCandidate to ensure a single MIP-03 comparator.

dependencies_forbidden: No imports from src/client/ in src/core/
No direct mutation of #state bypassing the setter
external_ports: EpochSnapshotStoreBackend (storage seam — injected, already wired by S1)
